title: People
description: Enrolled voiceprints used to identify speakers across recordings. Voiceprints are biometric data - only enrol people with their consent, and erase them when required.
empty: No people yet. Enrol someone from a recording's speaker (“+ New person…”).
confirmDelete: Delete "{{name}}"? Auto-identified labels revert; typed names are kept.
pageDescription: Everyone who appears in your meetings. A person does not need a voiceprint - add a colleague or a client before you have ever recorded them.
noneSelected: Select someone to edit their details.
fieldInternal: Internal - a colleague rather than an outside party
optOutHint: Diariz will not hold a voiceprint for this person or recognise them by voice.
optOutSelfHint: This is you, so this is always yours to change.
optOutLockedHint: Only someone who can manage people may change this.
confirmOptOut: Opt {{name}} out of voice-printing? This erases their voiceprint and every voice sample behind it, and stops them being recognised. Names Diariz applied automatically go back to the speaker label; names you typed are kept. Turning it off later does not bring the voiceprint back.
linkedFieldsLocked: This person has a Diariz account, so their name and email address come from their account.
voiceprintNoSamples: No recordings train this voiceprint yet.
attributionNoAccess: In a recording you cannot access.
errTrainingFailed: Could not change the training selection.
voiceprintOptedOut: This person has opted out of voice-printing, so there is nothing to select.
confirmEraseVoiceprint: Erase {{name}}'s voiceprint? They stay in the directory with their details; only the voiceprint and its samples go.
duplicatesHint: These look like the same person. Merging cannot be undone, so check before you do it.
errEmailInvalid: That does not look like an email address.
errSaveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
mergeEffectSamples: {{samples}} and the voiceprint they train move to {{name}}.
mergeEffectGains: {{name}} picks up: {{fields}}. Details it already has are kept as they are.
mergeEffectAccount: {{name}} becomes the person for that Diariz account.
mergeEffectRelabel: Speakers labelled "{{source}}" in any recording are relabelled "{{target}}".
mergeEffectFinal: "{{name}}" is deleted. This cannot be undone.
mergeBlockedBothAccounts: These records each have a Diariz account, so they are two different people - however alike the names look. Merging them would cut one of them off from their own account, so it is not allowed.
dismissDuplicateHint: Hide this suggestion while you are here. It comes back next time you open People.
